name: ImbalancedChen.attachedUpperCoefficient
type: ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → (ℕ → List ℕ → Bool) → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → ℕ → ℝ

name: ImbalancedChen.attachedUpperCoefficient_majorant
type:
∀ {nu r epsilon : ℝ},
  0 < nu →
    0 < epsilon →
      epsilon ≤ 1 →
        epsilon ^ 2 ≤ r →
          ∀ (retain : ℕ → List ℕ → Bool) (cap : ℕ → ℕ) {N : ℕ},
            2 ≤ N →
              ↑N ^ (nu * r) ≤ ↑(cap N) →
                ∀ (n : ℕ),
                  (if n.Coprime (ImbalancedChen.sieveProduct N ⌈↑N ^ (nu * r)⌉₊) then 1 else 0) ≤
                    ImbalancedChen.physicalDivisorSum (ImbalancedChen.attachedUpperModuli nu r epsilon retain cap N)
                      (ImbalancedChen.attachedUpperCoefficient nu r epsilon retain cap N) n

name: ImbalancedChen.attachedUpperModuli
type: ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → (ℕ → List ℕ → Bool) → (ℕ → ℕ) → ℕ → Finset ℕ

name: ImbalancedChen.eventually_RealB_le_currentK_log_of_actual_density_distribution
type:
∀ {b kappa nu r : ℝ},
  0 < b →
    b < 1 →
      0 < kappa →
        0 < nu →
          0 < r →
            nu * r < 1 →
              nu * r < (1 - kappa) * (b / (1 + b)) →
                ∀ (epsilon : ℝ → ℝ) (retain : ℝ → ℕ → List ℕ → Bool) (cap : ℝ → ℕ → ℕ),
                  (∀ (delta : ℝ), 0 < delta → 0 < epsilon delta ∧ epsilon delta ≤ 1 ∧ epsilon delta ^ 2 ≤ r) →
                    (∀ (delta : ℝ), 0 < delta → ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ↑N ^ (nu * r) ≤ ↑(cap delta N)) →
                      (∀ (delta : ℝ),
                          0 < delta →
                            ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                              Even N →
                                ImbalancedChen.physicalDensitySum
                                    (ImbalancedChen.attachedUpperModuli nu r (epsilon delta) (retain delta) (cap delta)
                                      N)
                                    (ImbalancedChen.attachedUpperCoefficient nu r (epsilon delta) (retain delta)
                                      (cap delta) N) ≤
                                  (ImbalancedChen.currentK + delta) * (ImbalancedChen.singularSeries N / Real.log ↑N)) →
                        (∀ (delta : ℝ),
                            0 < delta →
                              ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                                Even N →
                                  |ImbalancedChen.realPhysicalDistributionError b N
                                        (ImbalancedChen.manuscriptHalfProductCutoff kappa N)
                                        (ImbalancedChen.attachedUpperModuli nu r (epsilon delta) (retain delta)
                                          (cap delta) N)
                                        (ImbalancedChen.attachedUpperCoefficient nu r (epsilon delta) (retain delta)
                                          (cap delta) N)| ≤
                                    delta * ImbalancedChen.singularNormalization N) →
                          ∀ (tolerance : ℝ),
                            0 < tolerance →
                              ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                                Even N →
                                  ↑(ImbalancedChen.RealB b N) ≤
                                    (ImbalancedChen.currentK * Real.log (1 / b) + tolerance) *
                                      ImbalancedChen.singularNormalization N

name: ImbalancedChen.eventually_attachedUpper_coprimeCorrection_eq_zero
type:
∀ {b kappa nu r epsilon : ℝ},
  0 < b →
    0 < nu →
      0 ≤ r →
        epsilon ^ 2 ≤ r →
          nu * r < (1 - kappa) * (b / (1 + b)) →
            ∀ (retain : ℕ → List ℕ → Bool) (cap : ℕ → ℕ),
              ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
                ImbalancedChen.realPhysicalCoprimeCorrection b N (ImbalancedChen.manuscriptHalfProductCutoff kappa N)
                    (ImbalancedChen.attachedUpperModuli nu r epsilon retain cap N)
                    (ImbalancedChen.attachedUpperCoefficient nu r epsilon retain cap N) =
                  0

name: ImbalancedChen.eventually_manuscript_sieve_gate
type:
∀ {b kappa theta : ℝ},
  0 < b →
    0 ≤ theta →
      theta < (1 - kappa) * (b / (1 + b)) →
        ∀ᶠ (N : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
          0 < ImbalancedChen.manuscriptHalfProductCutoff kappa N ∧
            ↑⌈↑N ^ theta⌉₊ ≤ ImbalancedChen.manuscriptHalfProductCutoff kappa N ^ (b / (1 + b))

name: ImbalancedChen.exists_actualCompiledRho_density_budget
type:
∃ B,
  0 < B ∧
    ∀ (nu : ℝ),
      0 < nu →
        ∀ (epsilon : ℝ),
          0 < epsilon →
            epsilon < 1 / 8 →
              ∃ N₀,
                2 ≤ N₀ ∧
                  ∀ (N : ℕ),
                    N₀ ≤ N →
                      Even N →
                        ∀ (cap : ℕ),
                          ↑N ^ (nu * epsilon ^ 2) ≤ ↑cap →
                            ∀ (rough : Finset ℕ),
                              (∀ d ∈ rough, ImbalancedChen.RoughPrimeSupportedAt (↑N ^ (nu * epsilon ^ 2)) d) →
                                ∀ (compiled raw : ℕ → ℝ) (rawBound reserve : ℝ),
                                  have w := ↑N ^ (nu * epsilon ^ 2);
                                  have L := ↑N ^ (nu * epsilon);
                                  have small := ImbalancedChen.actualSmallRosserSupport N cap w;
                                  have density := fun c =>
                                    ImbalancedChen.physicalDensitySum (ImbalancedChen.smallRoughModuli small rough)
                                      (ImbalancedChen.smallRoughRho small rough c
                                        (ImbalancedChen.actualSmallRosserMinus N cap w L)
                                        (ImbalancedChen.actualSmallRosserPlus N cap w L));
                                  density raw ≤ rawBound * (ImbalancedChen.singularSeries N / Real.log ↑N) →
                                    (ImbalancedChen.reciprocalTotientDensity rough fun d => |compiled d - raw d|) ≤
                                        reserve * (nu * epsilon ^ 2) / B →
                                      rawBound + reserve ≤ ImbalancedChen.currentK →
                                        density compiled ≤
                                          ImbalancedChen.currentK * (ImbalancedChen.singularSeries N / Real.log ↑N)

name: ImbalancedChen.exists_actualCompiledRho_density_difference_bound
type:
∃ C K,
  0 < C ∧
    1 < K ∧
      ∀ (epsilon : ℝ),
        0 < epsilon →
          epsilon < 1 / 8 →
            ∃ D₀,
              2 ≤ D₀ ∧
                ∀ (D : ℝ),
                  D₀ ≤ D →
                    ∀ (N cap : ℕ),
                      Even N →
                        ∀ (rough : Finset ℕ),
                          (∀ d ∈ rough, ImbalancedChen.RoughPrimeSupportedAt (D ^ epsilon ^ 2) d) →
                            ∀ (compiled raw : ℕ → ℝ),
                              have w := D ^ epsilon ^ 2;
                              have L := D ^ epsilon;
                              have small := ImbalancedChen.actualSmallRosserSupport N cap w;
                              have density := fun c =>
                                ImbalancedChen.physicalDensitySum (ImbalancedChen.smallRoughModuli small rough)
                                  (ImbalancedChen.smallRoughRho small rough c
                                    (ImbalancedChen.actualSmallRosserMinus N cap w L)
                                    (ImbalancedChen.actualSmallRosserPlus N cap w L));
                              |density compiled - density raw| ≤
                                ImbalancedChen.actualSmallEulerProduct N cap w *
                                    (1 + ImbalancedChen.actualSmallRosserDensityError C K D epsilon) *
                                  ImbalancedChen.reciprocalTotientDensity rough fun d => |compiled d - raw d|

                                      ImbalancedChen.reciprocalTotientDensity rough fun d => |compiled d - raw d|) *
